study_note: One outer-adapt H3/J8/K1 Humanoid Walk run, seed 55, one million decisions: existing BOOM sampled-action alignment with lambda 0.0126 (0.03 times 0.42). Matches W&B run 03bc3869a52b4a69a64d180fc28f4d1e scientifically except lambda 0.0042 becomes 0.0126. Retains S > 2 gating, post-tanh entropy alpha 0.0021, strict compilation, whole-inner CUDA graphs, GPU replay, vmap critics, TF32-high, and periodic critic geometry. This is a coefficient ablation of the existing BOOM implementation.
